rationale: The last 1-minute candle shows a bearish reversal — price ran to the session high of $20.97 and closed back at $20.76, suggesting exhaustion near the top of the range (87.5% of today's range). The stock is already up ~8% from prior close on a neutral earnings catalyst, and the spread of 29 bps on a $20 stock adds friction. With price extended well above VWAP ($19.97) and showing a potential topping wick at the high, neither a clean long continuation nor a short entry with defined risk is compelling enough to justify adding exposure alongside the existing FIVN position.
